Clinical research

Clinical execution for multicenter studies.

UNAMIS brings together associated investigators, clinical operations and dedicated infrastructure for studies in Mérida and throughout the Yucatán Peninsula.

Operating model

Preparation, conduct and follow-up

The site coordinates feasibility, activation, enrollment and participant follow-up in accordance with the protocol, ethical requirements and applicable regulations. Eligibility is assessed individually through informed consent and protocol-defined criteria.

Investigators and coordination

A multidisciplinary network of investigators, clinical coordinators and support staff.

Quality and data

Operational processes, Good Clinical Practice training and experience with clinical data platforms.

Clinical infrastructure

Dedicated consultation rooms, infusion area, cold-chain pharmacy, sample processing and monitoring spaces.

Therapeutic experience

Multidisciplinary portfolio

Specialties

Rheumatology, oncology, gastroenterology, pediatrics, dermatology, infectious diseases, nephrology and endocrinology.

Populations

Adults, adolescents, pediatric participants and healthy volunteers, according to each protocol.

Study designs

Phase 2, 3 and 4 interventional studies, as well as observational and follow-up research.
